title: heracleum dulce var. akasimontanum
intro: Heracleum dulce var. akasimontanum, commonly known as wild angelica or mountain angelica, is a species of plant in the carrot family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and is used to treat various conditions including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Heracleum dulce var. akasimontanum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
